instruction_variants: Pick the mug from the counter and place it under the coffee machine dispenser.
Move the empty mug from the marked counter position to the placement zone under the dispenser.
マグカップをカウンターから取り、コーヒーマシンのディスペンサー下へ置いてください。
tasks.notes: Source task: RoboCasa CoffeeSetupMug, which uses obj_groups="mug", places it on the counter at initialization, and checks placement under the coffee-machine dispenser. This Atlas record is deliberately re-grounded to the real catalog object ycb_025_mug as a proposal; no individual RoboCasa mug asset ID is exposed by the cited object documentation, and model equivalence and compatibility remain unknown. The empty, clean, unpowered, and cool setup conditions are conservative Atlas collection-design assumptions, not source task requirements. Atlas graph walk: this TaskInstance --acts_on--> ycb_025_mug --instance_of--> concept:object_drinkware (two existing Atlas relation edges). The coffee-machine fixture, under-dispenser placement zone, and associated counter are explicit external resource requirements; the zone ID names the source placement area, not a separate asset. No brewing, button press, or liquid handling is included.

tasks.notes: Source task: RoboCasa CoffeeServeMug, which uses obj_groups="mug", initializes it under the coffee-machine dispenser, and checks placement on the associated counter. This is a distinct reverse pick-and-place primitive at the same Atlas class as CoffeeSetupMug. The YCB ycb_025_mug substitution is proposed; no individual RoboCasa mug asset ID, model equivalence, or compatibility is established. The empty, clean, unpowered, and cool setup conditions are conservative Atlas collection-design assumptions, not source task requirements. Atlas graph walk: this TaskInstance --acts_on--> ycb_025_mug --instance_of--> concept:object_drinkware (two existing Atlas relation edges). The coffee-machine fixture, under-dispenser placement zone, and associated counter are explicit external resource requirements; the zone ID names the source placement area, not a separate asset. The task only moves the mug; it does not claim coffee was brewed or served, and excludes button operation and liquid handling.

procedures.label: Move the mug from the counter under the dispenser

steps.description: Locate the marked mug, coffee-machine counter, and designated dispenser placement zone.
Approach the mug while keeping clear of the machine and dispenser.
Acquire a stable hold on the empty mug.
Lift the mug clear of the counter.
Place the mug in the designated dispenser placement zone beneath the dispenser.
Release the mug after stable placement.
Verify the mug is under the dispenser, stable, upright, and still empty.

draft_notes: This is an isolated proposed bundle. Its two task IDs are unique reference_robocasa records and are not an active YCB batch.

The source primitives are exactly CoffeeSetupMug (counter to under the coffee-machine dispenser) and CoffeeServeMug (under the dispenser to the associated counter), declared in the official RoboCasa kitchen_coffee.py. Both source configurations use obj_groups="mug".

Each task uses the real Atlas object ycb_025_mug, whose existing general_concept_id is object_drinkware. Requested two-edge Atlas walk for each task: TaskInstance --acts_on--> ycb_025_mug --instance_of--> concept:object_drinkware. CoffeeServeMug is the second distinct primitive at that same ObjectClass.

Reviewed active YCB mug tasks in rounds 1-5: handover, interior/handle inspection, pouring a cool surrogate into the mug, place-setting preparation, and handle-clearance measurement. Neither source primitive duplicates these goals: both move the mug between the counter and the dispenser-side placement zone, and neither transfers liquid, brews coffee, or serves a person.

Cross-resource note: RoboCasa samples a generic mug group. This draft proposes re-grounding that role to ycb_025_mug; no individual RoboCasa mug model ID is available in the cited docs, and equivalence, fit, and asset compatibility remain unknown.

External resource requirements are expressed by stable snake_case IDs in task bindings, state predicates, and planning requirements: robocasa_resource_coffee_machine (source fixture), robocasa_resource_coffee_dispenser_zone (the described under-dispenser placement area), and robocasa_resource_coffee_machine_counter (the counter associated with the machine fixture). The maintained Atlas contract represents such resources as planning requirements; this schema has no standalone resource-node collection.

Both tasks are movement-only: no coffee-machine button operation, brewing, hot liquid, or serving claim is included. Empty/clean/unpowered/cool checks are explicit conservative Atlas design assumptions, not RoboCasa source requirements. All time estimates remain null because no Atlas collection times were measured.

The official RoboCasa code and registry URLs are pinned to repository commit 4f8a2980def75a55dff96b990745b83540425f09. Registry horizon values are benchmark limits and are not used as task time estimates.
